rationale: T068 is truthful as a local verification boundary: it directly invokes Next, forces non-standalone verification mode, propagates exit status, and current output has no standalone or reparse trees. Default production remains standalone and Docker behavior is preserved. Fresh post-boundary browser and accessibility evidence is missing; previous visual baselines materially mismatched and remain unapproved.

worker_package.objective: Run one sole post-T068 homepage runtime diagnostics pass: safely clean only apps/web/.next, then use Playwright on the dedicated 127.0.0.1:3101 dev server for fresh smoke, accessibility, and light-desktop, 390px-mobile, and dark visual diagnostics. Preserve source, configuration, content, provenance, tests/browser/snapshots, and Docker behavior. Capture truthful exit statuses and actual/diff/trace artifacts. Never approve or update visual baselines.
verify: Guard exact apps/web/.next target; reject reparse-point root and remove only individually validated reparse-point children without following links.
Before every Playwright command inspect 127.0.0.1:3101; proceed only when FREE or owned by this workspace and record PID/command line.
Run pnpm e2e and record fresh browser/runtime results.
Run pnpm a11y and record complete accessibility result.
Run pnpm visual:check and record light desktop, 390px mobile, and dark actual/expected/diff/trace diagnostics and real exit status.
Verify tests/browser/snapshots and homepage/source/configuration hashes are unchanged; visual:update is forbidden.
Verify writes are limited to apps/web/.next and test-results and no reparse points remain in generated output.
stop_if: Cleanup target is not exactly apps/web/.next, root is a reparse point, or a link cannot be removed safely without following it.
Port 3101 is occupied by an unknown process or ownership cannot be established.
Browser or accessibility command fails twice for the same cause, or fresh runtime artifacts cannot be persisted.
visual:update runs, snapshots change, assertions are weakened, or visual mismatches are approved.
Any source, snapshot, report, content, provenance, configuration, Docker, documentation, search, governance, operations, or external-system change is required.
Any write or deletion affects a path outside apps/web/.next or test-results.

evidence: T068 records pnpm build:verify passing twice with output guards, exit propagation, unchanged source/configuration/Dockerfile hashes, and preserved default standalone behavior.
Current apps/web/.next has no standalone, .turbo, test-results, or reparse entries after verification build.
T066 recorded e2e 4/4 and accessibility 4/4, but visual diagnostics recorded 3/3 mismatches with snapshots unchanged.
Current test-results contains actual/expected/diff PNGs and traces dated before the T068 build output.
Playwright uses 127.0.0.1:3101 with reuseExistingServer false and a dedicated Chromium project.

parallel_safety.reason: Generated output, Playwright server ownership, browser artifacts, and visual snapshots share one runtime boundary; run one sole Worker.

missing_evidence: Fresh post-T068 smoke/browser and accessibility results.
Fresh light desktop, 390px mobile, and dark visual diagnostics after the boundary change.
Persisted current actual/diff/trace evidence with unchanged snapshots and no baseline approval.
Repository-backed raster-media licensing/provenance and truthful Bodoni Moda, Inter, and IBM Plex Mono font-loading evidence.
Completion of documentation ingestion, search, governance, hardening, operations, and external activation workstreams.
